testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel inserting a model-state table row ✔ Given The MCAD Software has a model-state table with Primary, Capture State, and Copy State in that order ✔ And Capture State has extrusion status Suppress and d0 value 1 in ✔ When the user opens the context menu on the Capture State row number ✔ Then Insert Row and Delete Row are available ✔ And the default-row, parameter-range and column commands appear disabled ✔ When the user chooses Insert Row ✔ Then a generated member row appears immediately after Capture State ✔ And the new row shows extrusion status Suppress and d0 value 1 in ✔ And OK is enabled ✔ When the user cancels and reopens the table ✔ Then only the original three member rows are shown in their original order
